component.name: Nimbus 2015 Fonts
component.summary: Nimbus fonts with added Greek and Cyrillic glyphs

description.p: The Nimbus 2015 Core fonts added Greek and Cyrillic glyphs. This package may be best suited as an add-on to the comprehensive Times package, providing support for Greek and Cyrillic. A new intermediate weight of NimbusMono (AKA Courier) is provided, along with a narrower version which may be useful for rendering code.
